content.text: Digital creators in Kenya often face barriers when trying to monetize their work online. Traditional payment processors like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-actually-how-works-6|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal are either inaccessible or heavily restricted, leaving many creators without viable solutions. However, with the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-6|The Real]], [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-explained-digital-18|automated]] ebook delivery after a crypto payment is not just possible; it’s also efficient and secure. This post will walk you through how you can leverage sovereign commerce infrastructure to create a seamless purchase experience for your customers, enabling them to receive their digital products instantly upon payment confirmation. No more waiting days for funds to clear—welcome to the future of digital commerce.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-5. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery powered by crypto payments eliminates the dependence on traditional payment platforms that often exclude creators in certain regions. This system allows digital creators to distribute their products efficiently while ensuring they maintain full control over their transactions and data. The core of this infrastructure is built on freely available technologies that operate without reliance on centralized services. By employing a method where payment transactions trigger automatic deliveries, creators can offer instant gratification to customers. This not only enhances the customer experience but also fosters trust, encouraging repeat purchases. In markets where conventional payment processors are unavailable, this sovereignty in commerce infrastructure becomes not just beneficial but essential for thriving as a digital creator.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of this automated ebook delivery system consists of several key components working in unison. When a customer completes a crypto payment, a webhook from NOWPayments notifies the backend system, typically built using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This backend logic verifies the payment on the blockchain. Once confirmed, it triggers a script that automatically sends the ebook to the customer via email or directs them to a download link. Storing order records can be managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, allowing for easy retrieval and management of customer data. By leveraging these technologies, the entire process—from payment to product delivery—occurs in real-time, ensuring that creators can provide immediate access to their digital products while maintaining a secure and decentralized operation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions like Kenya where conventional payment systems are either unavailable or cumbersome. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this setup empowers you to operate independently. By eliminating reliance on platforms like Stripe or PayPal, creators gain sovereignty over their business processes. This autonomy in processing payments and delivering products ensures they can reach their audience without barriers. Further, creators can focus on developing quality content instead of navigating the complexities of traditional payment systems. This approach resonates with those who seek to build a sustainable and scalable digital business on their own terms.
Automate your ebook delivery and eliminate payment delays.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The automated delivery system is composed of several critical components. Firstly, a reliable hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages is essential for storing product files and hosting your storefront. The backend logic handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script acts as the brain behind the operation, processing payment confirmations and executing delivery scripts. NOWPayments serves as the gateway for crypto transactions, allowing customers to pay with various cryptocurrencies without the need for KYC or account restrictions. Finally, using Supabase or Google Sheets to maintain order data ensures you have a complete record of transactions for future reference. Together, these parts create a cohesive infrastructure that enables creators to manage their digital products and payments seamlessly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this automated ebook delivery system, start by acquiring the Complete Builder Kit for $197, which includes comprehensive documentation and templates. Set up your storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your products. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions efficiently. Next, configure either Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for your backend logic to process payment notifications. Once the payment is confirmed, implement a delivery script that will send the ebook to your customers. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to log order details and provide customer support where needed. Finally, test the system thoroughly to ensure every component works seamlessly before going live. With these steps completed, you will have a fully functioning automated delivery system in place.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Automated ebook delivery after a crypto payment allows digital creators to streamline their sales process by offering instant access to products while bypassing traditional payment barriers. By using components like Cloudflare Workers for back-end processing and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions, creators can ensure their customers receive their purchases immediately upon payment confirmation. This system emphasizes ownership and sovereignty, giving creators full control over their sales without needing services like Stripe or PayPal.
Gain full control over your digital commerce without relying on traditional platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit for $197 to gain access to all necessary resources. 2. Set up your product hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Integrate NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency payments. 4. Choose either Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic. 5. Create a delivery script that triggers when a payment is confirmed, sending the ebook to the customer. 6. Set up Supabase or Google Sheets to record transactions and customer data. 7. Test the entire system to ensure everything operates smoothly before launching.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I use for payments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you flexibility in accepting various digital currencies for your products.
How quickly can I set this up?
With the Complete Builder Kit, you can have your automated delivery system up and running in as little as 48 hours.
Do I need technical skills to implement this?
While some familiarity with web technologies is helpful, the Complete Builder Kit provides step-by-step documentation to guide you through the process.
What if my customers face issues with payment?
NOWPayments offers support for transaction queries, and you can manage customer service through your backend setup.
Can I change products easily once the system is set up?
Yes, you can update your product listings and delivery scripts at any time to accommodate new offerings or changes.
